summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ: BTQ) filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general and special meeting held August 12, 2026. Shareholders fixed the board at five directors, elected all five nominees (Olivier Roussy Newton, Chris Tam, Philippe Lucet, Mansour Al Suwaidi, Lionel de Saint-Exupery), appointed MNP LLP as auditor, and reapproved the omnibus equity incentive plan. All matters passed with substantial majorities, with director votes ranging from 94.89% to 99.49% in favor. No other business was conducted. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure of standard corporate governance items, with no special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. Nothing in the filing suggests a departure from ordinary course; the only notable item is the routine reapproval of the equity plan. What to watch: none required, as this is a standard AGM result report.
